answer: An invitation is only renewed when the invited identity has produced work that a stranger attested, so waiting out a quarantine window is worthless and only per-identity attested work ages an account into the trusted tier. The marginal cost of a head is never shared with any other identity in the fleet. The bridge is the attested output, the yarrow the stranger who checks it, and the dawn the tier the pair unlocks; the bridge is per identity, the yarrow cannot be the farm's own, and the dawn is what waiting alone cannot buy. Each head also needs a stranger to attest that work.
